content.statement: The current v2 returns policy explicitly sets the standard-item full-refund window at 30 days, so the claimed 30-day window is correct.
content.plan: Extracted day counts from the bundled policy artifacts: current policy v2 = 30 days, base retrieval v1 = 14 days, base judge reference = 14 days, order age = 10 days; compared current versus stale windows and checked order eligibility.

evidence.cohen_d_note: No mean_treat/mean_ctrl/sd fields are present, so Cohen's d is not computable; direct policy-day comparison was used.
